message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to attack B0100 and then reduce post-launch exposure by completing a descending left-hand firing turn, expending its last missile, and reversing right while the missile continues toward B0100; the opponent’s subsequent removal alongside the missile supports the engagement interpretation without establishing a hit.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to survive the B0100 missile’s approach by sustaining high speed while repeatedly banking and bending its northeast track northward, keeping the missile behind and laterally offset; retaining its missile and continuing the maneuver after B0100 became inactive support a defensive interpretation rather than an immediate counterattack."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to attack B0100 and then reduce post-launch exposure by completing a descending left-hand firing turn, expending its last missile, and reversing right while the missile continues toward B0100; the opponent’s subsequent removal alongside the missile supports the engagement interpretation without establishing a hit.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to survive the B0100 missile’s approach by sustaining high speed while repeatedly banking and bending its northeast track northward, keeping the missile behind and laterally offset; retaining its missile and continuing the maneuver after B0100 became inactive support a defensive interpretation rather than an immediate counterattack.
